description: This file defines the IStreamProvider interface and extension methods for stream retrieval in the Orleans streaming framework.

classes.name: StreamProviderExtensions
classes.description: Contains extension methods for IStreamProvider to retrieve streams by various identifiers.

methods.name: GetStream<T>(StreamId streamId)
methods.description: Retrieves a stream of type T using a StreamId.

methods.name: GetStream<T>(Guid id)
methods.description: Retrieves a stream of type T using a Guid, creating a StreamId with null namespace.

methods.name: GetStream<T>(string ns, Guid id)
methods.description: Retrieves a stream of type T using a namespace and Guid.

methods.name: GetStream<T>(string id)
methods.description: Retrieves a stream of type T using a string id, creating a StreamId with null namespace.

methods.name: GetStream<T>(string ns, string id)
methods.description: Retrieves a stream of type T using a namespace and string id.

methods.name: GetStream<T>(long id)
methods.description: Retrieves a stream of type T using a long id, creating a StreamId with null namespace.

methods.name: GetStream<T>(string ns, long id)
methods.description: Retrieves a stream of type T using a namespace and long id.
